description: This file defines the EntityViewBuilder class in Drupal, responsible for rendering entity views, managing cache, and handling recursive rendering protection within the Drupal core entity API.

classes.name: EntityViewBuilder
classes.description: Base class for entity view builders in Drupal, handling rendering, caching, and recursion protection for entity views.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of EntityViewBuilder using dependency injection container and entity type.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Renders a single entity in a specified view mode, adding a pre-render callback.

methods.name: viewMultiple
methods.description: Prepares multiple entities for rendering, applying defaults and alterations.

methods.name: getBuildDefaults
methods.description: Provides default build array for an entity, including cache and theme settings.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Prepares a single entity's render array, calling buildMultiple.

methods.name: buildMultiple
methods.description: Builds render arrays for multiple entities, handling display components and hooks.

methods.name: buildComponents
methods.description: Builds render arrays for entity components, grouped by bundle.

methods.name: addContextualLinks
methods.description: Adds contextual links to the entity render array if applicable.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags for the entity view.

methods.name: resetCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache for specific entities or all entity views.

methods.name: isViewModeCacheable
methods.description: Determines if a view mode is cacheable based on display settings.

methods.name: viewField
methods.description: Renders a specific field of an entity with display options.

methods.name: viewFieldItem
methods.description: Renders a single field item, cloning the entity for isolated rendering.

methods.name: getSingleFieldDisplay
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a display configuration for rendering a single field.

methods.name: setRecursiveRenderProtection
methods.description: Pre-render callback to prevent recursive rendering of entities.

methods.name: unsetRecursiveRenderProtection
methods.description: Post-render callback to remove recursion tracking after rendering.

methods.name: getRenderRecursionKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for recursion protection based on entity and view mode.
